integrity: The center and rank are proved symbolically from the Ore-extension relations and PBW basis; the exact PI degree is derived from the \(16\)-dimensional central quotient division algebra. No finite experiment is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to characteristic \(2\), \(f=0\), and nonzero \(\gamma\). The result does not cover the full deformation family or the \(\gamma=0\) degeneration. An older equivalent statement under a solvable-Lie classification label remains a residual literature risk.
title: Exact center and PI degree four for a characteristic-two Bell–Li Ore subfamily
